data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly asks the arguer to identify what evidence would distinguish failure modes that are truly independent from failures that merely appear uncorrelated until a shared cause is found. SRC_001 never addresses this evidentiary question at all. It redefines resilience in terms of design diversity and argues that component redundancy is illusory against shared design flaws, but it provides no discussion of what observations, tests, or evidence would let one tell apart a set of node failures that are genuinely independent from a set that only looks independent because the shared cause has not yet been discovered. This is a direct omission of a required component of the problem as stated.
